verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for an orchestration framework and its Agent Server APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of versioned APIs, semver guarantees, or a deprecation policy. One community report (langgraph-comm-6) cites frequent breaking changes, but with no vendor claim to contradict, that cannot make this 'disputed'. Absence of evidence yields 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
